project_state.name: DraftReviewr
project_state.summary: Review results now support optional 0-100 scoring, score badges, average score display, and inline prompt editing from the result dialog.
project_state.runtime: Next.js 15.2.4 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4.

modules.name: score-schema
modules.public_surface: ReviewResult includes optional score?: number for backward-compatible scored review results.

modules.name: score-storage-contract
modules.public_surface: Provider ReviewResult and reviewResultStorage.create() accept score?: number; document upload mapping passes score to localStorage.

modules.name: llm-score-output
modules.public_surface: All non-streaming providers and the legacy fallback request SCORE output and parse completed responses into optional scores.

modules.name: score-display-ui
modules.public_surface: Review result dialog renders per-result score badges and an overall average score summary when scored results exist.

modules.name: prompt-edit-in-results
modules.public_surface: Review result dialog allows inline editing of review item prompts with localStorage updates and immediate local state refresh.

routes.integration: Document review upload flow stores optional score values and the document history opens scored/editable review results.

integration_points: components/documents/document-review-dialog.tsx (score badges, average summary, inline prompt editing)
lib/openai-client.ts (legacy fallback SCORE instruction and parsing)

score_contract.display: 80-100 green, 50-79 amber, 0-49 red. Missing score renders no badge.

prompt_edit_contract.target: Review item prompt only; review result markdown is read-only.
prompt_edit_contract.storage: commonReviewItemStorage.update() or reviewItemStorage.update() based on result item id.
prompt_edit_contract.ui_update: Local results state is updated directly after save; fetchResults() is not called.

verification.note: Home route loaded with expected Korean document review UI text.

known_issues: phases/3-provider-model-ui/index.json still has stale pending step statuses even though top-level phase status, baseline, tag, and git history show phase 3 completed.
There is no dedicated test script in package.json; current verification relies on typecheck, build, phase validation, and targeted UI/browser checks.
